patterns.message: apps/api may not import from UI. Share code through @rch/contract or @rch/domain (see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-03-backend-design.md §5.1).
UI may not import from apps/api. Share code through @rch/contract or @rch/domain (see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-03-backend-design.md §5.1).
Screens read/write through useApp, not api/client directly (see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-03-backend-design.md §5.1). UI may not import from apps/api either.
